qualification.details: Qualification: PG Degree in Homoeopathy recognized under Homoeopathy Central Council Act, 1973/National Commission for Homoeopathy (NCH) Act, 2020; Enrolment in the Central/State Register of Homoeopathy; At least 05 (Five) quality research papers/work published in reputed peer reviewed indexed research journals, excluding post-graduate/post-doctoral publications Experience: 20 years of Research/Teaching experience in Group 'A' level post having: an analogous post in Pay Level-14; OR minimum 3 years regular service in Pay Level-13 (Rs.1,23,100-Rs.2,15,900) or equivalent; OR 8 years regular service in Pay Level-12 (Rs.78,800-Rs.2,09,200) or equivalent Age limit: Maximum 58 years (as on last date of submission of application) | Other conditions: | Professional experience means experience obtained after enrolment in the Central/State Register of Homoeopathy Sponsoring authority to verify the particulars and eligibility of the candidate while forwarding the application | Desirable: | Administrative experience in Central/State Government, Government Autonomous Bodies, Research Undertakings or Semi-Government Statutory or Autonomous Organizations funded by the Government Ph.D. in Homoeopathy, OR Ph.D. in Public Health/Integrated Clinical Research/Clinical Research from a recognized University Clinical experience in the field of Homoeopathy

salary_details.pay_scale: Level-14 of 7th CPC Pay Matrix, Rs. 1,44,200-2,18,200 plus NPA and other usual allowances

how_to_apply: Download the application form (Annexure-II) from the Ministry of Ayush website https://ayush.gov.in.
Fill the form in the prescribed format and paste a self-attested latest passport size photograph.
Enclose attested photocopies of qualifications, mark sheets, internship training, registration certificate and experience documents.
Departmental candidates attach the Head of Office certificate and attested APARs for the last 5 years.

Send the application through proper channel so that it reaches Shri Jainul Abadin, Under Secretary, Homoeopathy Section, Ministry of Ayush, Ayush Bhavan, B-Block, GPO Complex, INA, New Delhi-110023 within 60 days from publication of the advertisement in Employment News/Rozgar Samachar.
Make sure it reaches by 7 January 2027.
important_instructions: No advance application will be entertained Applications received after the due date will be summarily rejected Hindi version of the circular will follow

rows.central_council_for_research_in_homoeopa: Level-14 of 7th CPC Pay Matrix, Rs. 1,44,200-2,18,200 plus NPA and other usual allowances
Central Council for Research in Homoeopathy (CCRH), New Delhi

PG Degree in Homoeopathy recognized under Homoeopathy Central Council Act, 1973 / National Commission for Homoeopathy (NCH) Act, 2020; enrolment in Central/State Register of Homoeopathy; 20 years of research/teaching experience in a Group 'A' level post; at least 5 quality research papers.
Maximum 58 years (as on last date of submission of application)
Shri Jainul Abadin, Under Secretary, Homoeopathy Section, Ministry of Ayush, Government of India, Ayush Bhavan, B-Block, GPO Complex, INA, New Delhi-110023

content_sections.heading: CCRH Notification PDF 2027
content_sections.text: Advt No. R.19013/3/2026-HS gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download CCRH notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: PG Degree in Homoeopathy recognized under Homoeopathy Central Council Act, 1973/National Commission for Homoeopathy (NCH) Act, 2020; Enrolment in the Central/State Register of Homoeopathy; At least 05 (Five) quality research papers/work published in reputed peer reviewed indexed research journals, excluding post-graduate/post-doctoral publications Experience: 20 years of Research/Teaching experience in Group 'A' level post having: an analogous post in Pay Level-14; OR minimum 3 years regular service in Pay Level-13 (Rs.1,23,100-Rs.2,15,900) or equivalent; OR 8 years regular service in Pay Level-12 (Rs.78,800-Rs.2,09,200) or equivalent Age limit: Maximum 58 years (as on last date of submission of application) Other conditions: Professional experience means experience obtained after enrolment in the Central/State Register of Homoeopathy Sponsoring authority to verify the particulars and eligibility of the candidate while forwarding the application Desirable: Administrative experience in Central/State Government, Government Autonomous Bodies, Research Undertakings or Semi-Government Statutory or Autonomous Organizations funded by the Government Ph.D. in Homoeopathy, OR Ph.D. in Public Health/Integrated Clinical Research/Clinical Research from a recognized University Clinical experience in the field of Homoeopathy

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: By deputation/short term contract for a tenure of 5 years or till the date the incumbent attains the age of superannuation, whichever is earlier Post is on deputation basis / short term contract for a period not exceeding 5 years

content_sections.heading: How Will CCRH Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Selection method Interview for candidates called Selection is stated to be through selection method Candidates called for interview are paid Second Class AC Railway fare to and fro by shortest route or Economy Class Air Fare (APEX Fare) as per rules

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-attested latest passport size photograph on the form Attested photocopies of general and technical qualifications and mark sheets of all examinations for the technical courses Internship training and Registration Certificate Experience documents Departmental candidates: certificate from Head of Office and attested photocopies of APARs for the last 5 years

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: No advance application will be entertained Applications received after the due date will be summarily rejected Hindi version of the circular will follow

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CCRH Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 7 January 2027.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CCRH Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Director General.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CCRH Recruitment 2027?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-II of the notice; also downloadable from https://ayush.gov.in) and send it to Shri Jainul Abadin, Under Secretary, Homoeopathy Section, Ministry of Ayush, Government of India, Ayush Bhavan, B-Block, GPO Complex, INA, New Delhi-110023, by through proper channel, to reach the under secretary, homoeopathy section, to reach by 7 January 2027.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 58 years (as on last date of submission of application).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Level-14 of 7th CPC Pay Matrix, Rs. 1,44,200-2,18,200 plus NPA and other usual allowances.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: PG Degree in Homoeopathy recognized under Homoeopathy Central Council Act, 1973 / National Commission for Homoeopathy (NCH) Act, 2020; enrolment in Central/State Register of Homoeopathy; 20 years of research/teaching experience in a Group 'A' level post; at least 5 quality research papers.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Professional experience means experience obtained after enrolment in the Central/State Register of Homoeopathy. Sponsoring authority to verify the particulars and eligibility of the candidate while forwarding the application.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection method. Interview for candidates called. Selection is stated to be through selection method. Candidates called for interview are paid Second Class AC Railway fare to and fro by shortest route or Economy Class Air Fare (APEX Fare) as per rules.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: By deputation/short term contract for a tenure of 5 years or till the date the incumbent attains the age of superannuation, whichever is earlier. Post is on deputation basis / short term contract for a period not exceeding 5 years.
